VIDEO SCRIPT: LISTENING FOR UNDERSTANDING IDENTIFYING KEY POINTS VOCABULARY ATTENTION
Grade: Grade 8 · Subject: FRENCH

[0:00–0:20] HOOK
• Host: “Today we learn Listening for understanding Identifying key points Vocabulary Attention. Watch the example, then you try.”

[0:20–2:00] TEACH
• Look, say, write.
• Use chunks for long words.
• Practise weekly.

[2:00–4:00] WORKED EXAMPLE ON SCREEN
• elephant (look-and-say)
• football = foot + ball
• sun → run → ran

[4:00–5:00] TRY THIS (PAUSE)
• Read 8 long words pointing under each.
• Chunk 5 compound words.
• Build one word ladder with 4 steps.

[5:00–5:30] REMEMBER + CTA
• Recap 3 bullets. “Now open Revision Quiz for Listening for understanding Identifying key points Vocabulary Attention.”
